text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest single-digit gains while the Fear & Greed Index sits at 22 (Extreme Fear), suggesting investors remain cautious despite slight upward price movement. Bitcoin's dominance at 55.6% combined with relatively low overall volume of $62B indicates the rally lacks conviction and conviction is concentrated in the largest assets. The 7-day improvement in sentiment from 15 to 22 hints at early stabilization, but we're still far from neutral territory.
